## Purpose and Entrypoints
PiliPlus is a Flutter third-party Bilibili client for Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, and macOS. The Dart application starts at `lib/main.dart`; application routing is centralized in `lib/router/app_pages.dart`. Native host shells bootstrap Flutter per platform, notably `android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/example/piliplus/MainActivity.kt`, `linux/runner/main.cc`, and `windows/runner/main.cpp`.

## Application Shell, Navigation, and Feature Pages
The app is organized as a large route-driven client: page directories generally pair `controller.dart` with `view.dart`, while shared layouts and reusable UI live separately. Main/tab composition is represented by `lib/pages/main/controller.dart`, `lib/pages/main/view.dart`, and shared shell components such as `lib/common/widgets/main_layout.dart`. Major domains include home/discovery, user/account, dynamic posts, search, live rooms, messaging, favorites, settings, and video.

## Network and Bilibili API Boundary
REST-like Bilibili interactions are concentrated in `lib/http/`, with API initialization and shared request behavior rooted in `lib/http/init.dart`, `lib/http/api.dart`, and `lib/http/retry_interceptor.dart`. Domain modules such as `lib/http/video.dart`, `lib/http/live.dart`, `lib/http/login.dart`, and `lib/http/dynamics.dart` isolate endpoint operations from page controllers. This is the primary boundary to Bilibili’s external services; requests must handle authentication, signing, retries, and API-specific errors.

## gRPC Protocol Integration
Generated Bilibili protocol models and hand-written request wrappers form a parallel transport layer under `lib/grpc/`. Core dispatch/request construction is in `lib/grpc/grpc_req.dart`; domain accessors include `lib/grpc/view.dart`, `lib/grpc/reply.dart`, and `lib/grpc/dyn.dart`. Generated protobuf contracts, for example `lib/grpc/bilibili/app/viewunite/v1.pb.dart`, should be treated as generated integration artifacts rather than application-domain code.

## Account, Session, and Persistent State
Multi-account and cookie/session concerns are encapsulated under `lib/utils/accounts/`, especially `lib/utils/accounts/account_manager/account_mgr.dart`, `lib/utils/accounts/grpc_headers.dart`, and `lib/utils/accounts/cookie_jar_adapter.dart`. General local persistence is abstracted through `lib/utils/storage.dart`, `lib/utils/storage_pref.dart`, and `lib/utils/storage_key.dart`. Page controllers consume these facilities rather than directly managing credentials or storage formats.

## Media Playback, Danmaku, and Downloads
Playback is a first-class subsystem, centered on the custom player plugin at `lib/plugin/pl_player/controller.dart` and `lib/plugin/pl_player/view/view.dart`. Video orchestration is in `lib/pages/video/controller.dart` and `lib/pages/video/view.dart`; it connects play URLs, settings, subtitles, danmaku, gestures, and content metadata. Background/offline media handling is separated into `lib/services/download/download_manager.dart` and `lib/services/download/download_service.dart`. Platform-specific Android media support exists in `android/app/src/main/java/com/example/piliplus/MediaHelper.java`; shader assets support optional video enhancement under `assets/shaders/`.

## Data Models and UI Rendering Boundary
Response/domain serialization is split between legacy models in `lib/models/` and broad endpoint-specific DTOs in `lib/models_new/`, e.g. `lib/models_new/video/video_detail/data.dart` and `lib/models_new/live/live_room_play_info/data.dart`. Controllers translate these API models into page state; views render them using common UI primitives from `lib/common/widgets/`. This separation is important because API schemas, transport code, and visual components evolve at different rates.

## Runtime, Packaging, and Delivery
Flutter/Dart is the shared runtime, with Android Gradle, iOS/macOS Xcode, and Linux/Windows CMake host infrastructure. Android also exposes native helper bridges through `android/app/src/main/java/com/example/piliplus/AndroidHelper.java` and Dart bindings in `lib/utils/android/bindings.g.dart`. CI builds platform artifacts via `.github/workflows/build.yml` and platform workflows. Desktop packaging is explicitly represented by `assets/linux/DEBIAN/control` and `windows/packaging/exe/inno_setup.iss`.
